jobs.name: s10_hurry
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. A customer in a coat with a bag on the shoulder leans over the pharmacy counter in a hurry, glancing at a wristwatch, impatient; the pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind the counter stays calm and friendly, about to ask a short question. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
jobs.meaning: человек спешит: «просто дайте что-нибудь, только быстро»

jobs.name: s10_ask
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind a plain pharmacy counter calmly asks one short question with a gentle open-palm gesture; the customer, relaxed now, answers willingly and nods. Background: only soft blurred shelves with plain unlabeled boxes in brand blues and greens; NO signs, NO boards, NO posters, NO price tags, NO labels, NO letters or text of any kind anywhere in the image.
jobs.meaning: спокойно задать один вопрос — посетитель охотно отвечает

jobs.name: s10_goal
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) at the pharmacy counter listens very attentively to a customer, leaning slightly forward, with an understanding expression; the customer explains their situation. Warm, respectful, professional mood. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
jobs.meaning: цель — понять человека, затем помочь или направить к врачу

jobs.name: s10_grateful
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. A customer walking away from the pharmacy counter with a small paper bag, turning back with a grateful smile and a small wave; the pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) smiles back warmly. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
